PHP, vueJS, NodeJS, NestJS, TypeScript, React, Tailwind, Vite, Docker on GitHub Actions/GHCR, Redis, AppSignal, Cloudflare MySQL, PostgreSQL

This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview

This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.
  • Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.
  • Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.

Your responsibilities

  • Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.
  • Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.
  • In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.
  • Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.
  • Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.

What you bring to the table

  • Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.
  • Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs.
  • Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes).
  • Real skill at directing AI coding agents with precision, and the judgement to tell strong output from weak. The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts.
  • A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement.
  • Independence and strong communication: you're comfortable owning hard problems in a remote-first team with little hand-holding, and you keep the team in the loop on your thinking as you go.

What's in it for you

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We seek an individual who combines an intricate understanding of modern AI and HPC research workloads with expertise in accelerated computing and architecture.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Partner directly with leading research labs, researchers, and university faculty as a trusted technical advisor: develop a keen understanding of their scientific goals and drive joint research projects at supercomputing scale.
  • Identify and accelerate high-impact workloads by integrating NVIDIA's frameworks, libraries, and core software stack into research projects, and help researchers amplify their impact through publications, conference presentations, and technical content.
  • Advocate for accelerated computing and Deep Learning, and deliver hands-on trainings, workshops, lectures, and demonstrations across NVIDIA's platforms, and mentor power users to become NVIDIA champions.
  • Track emerging research trends and turn gaps between researcher needs and NVIDIA's o erings into prototypical solutions and direct feedback to NVIDIA Engineering.
  • Maintain deep expertise in your domain while staying versatile across NVIDIA's full platform: GPUs, CPUs, networking, and software

What We Need To See

  • A graduate degree from a leading university in a STEM related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience running the large language model lifecycle across multi-node systems: training, fine-tuning, inference, serving, and/or agentic workflows.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with academic and research stakeholders, and to communicate complex ideas clearly to both expert and non-expert audiences.
  • Action oriented, analytical, self-motivated, and a passionate learner, with excellent organization skills to work in a heavily multi-tasked environment.
  • Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

  • A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research on large language models or foundation models and their applications.
  • A track record of thought leadership: high-impact publications, talks at academic conferences and workshops, as well as good understanding of scientific policy engagement, grant processes, or national/European research program structures.
  • Experience with NVIDIA's AI software stack, powered by CUDA and CUDA-X libraries, e.g. NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NeMo Framework, Megatron Bridge, NIM, TensorRT-LLM, Dynamo, NeMo Agent Toolkit, and Triton Inference Server, as well as the Nemotron open-model methodology.

As a Solutions Architect, there is travel involved (30% of the working time), as often the best way to figure things out is a face to-face meeting, but the job is not life on the road. We make heavy use of conferencing tools, and you are empowered to figure out how to get the job done and do what it takes to make our customers successful.

À propos de nous

L’université de Bordeaux est une grande université dynamique, responsable, attentive au bien-être de ses personnels. La rejoindre, c’est travailler dans un cadre privilégié au sein d’une communauté professionnelle particulièrement diverse et ouverte, en bénéficiant de dispositifs d’accueil et d’inclusion, de formation et de mobilité interne. C’est participer à une aventure académique, scientifique et humaine. C’est s’engager à relever les défis du XXIe siècle.

Au sein de Bordeaux School of Economics (BxSE), l’Université de Bordeaux développe BILBO (Behavioural Insights Laboratory Bordeaux), une nouvelle plateforme d’économie expérimentale et comportementale.

BILBO a pour objectif de permettre la conception et la mise en œuvre de protocoles expérimentaux destinés à étudier les comportements individuels et les dynamiques collectives. Elle constitue un outil transversal permettant de transformer des questions de recherche en expérimentations concrètes, reproductibles et utiles à la société.

Dans ce contexte nous recrutons un ingénieur informatique pour un CDD de 6 mois.

Mission

L’ingénieur aura pour mission de concevoir, déployer et faire évoluer l’environnement informatique de BILBO et d’assurer l’appui technique à la mise en œuvre des protocoles expérimentaux, en laboratoire, en ligne et sur le terrain.

L’objectif est de construire une architecture logicielle commune aux trois modalités d’expérimentation, robuste, sécurisée et évolutive.

Vos Missions Seront Les Suivantes

Déployer et faire évoluer l’infrastructure expérimentale

Dans La Phase De Lancement, L’ingénieur Participera à La Mise En Place De L’environnement Informatique Nécessaire Aux Premières Expérimentations

Déploiement et administration des applications, serveurs, bases de données et systèmes de sauvegarde et de synchronisation

Configuration et gestion du parc de tablettes et de postes informatiques

Sécurisation de la collecte et des flux de données

Documentation de l’architecture et prise en compte des exigences de sécurité, de protection des données et de reproductibilité.

Un premier projet « lab-in-the-field » auprès de viticulteurs permettra de configurer et tester le dispositif. Dans une seconde phase, l’ingénieur fera évoluer l’architecture afin d’en renforcer l’autonomie, la robustesse et le fonctionnement simultané des trois modalités d’expérimentation, notamment dans des contextes de mobilité.

Développer et programmer les expérimentations

Développer et adapter des applications expérimentales en Python et oTree

Concevoir les interfaces et fonctionnalités nécessaires aux protocoles

Tester, déboguer et optimiser les expérimentations avant leur déploiement

Accompagner les projets de recherche

L’ingénieur Apportera Un Appui Technique Aux Chercheurs, Enseignants-chercheurs Et Doctorants, De La Préparation Du Protocole à Son Déploiement

Analyser les besoins et traduire les protocoles en dispositifs expérimentaux opérationnels

Proposer des solutions adaptées aux contraintes scientifiques et aux terrains

Accompagner et former les utilisateurs aux outils de la plateforme

Assurer la maintenance et la pérennité des outils

Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive de l’infrastructure et des applications

Développer des outils facilitant la collecte, le contrôle qualité et l’export des données

Produire et maintenir la documentation technique

Assurer une veille sur les outils et méthodes utiles à l’expérimentation, notamment open source et liés à l’intelligence artificielle

Profil

Titulaire d'un diplôme en informatique, le poste s’adresse à un profil informatique polyvalent, disposant de solides compétences en développement Python/web et capable de déployer et administrer l’environnement système dans lequel fonctionnent ses applications (machine virtuelle). Autonome et force de proposition, l’ingénieur travaillera en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche et les services informatiques de l’université.Votre maitriser l'anglais professionnel écrit et oral.

  • Compétences en administration de systèmes Linux et de serveurs web : installation, configuration, déploiement, mises à jour, sauvegardes et supervision ;
  • Capacité à déployer et maintenir des applications web dans un environnement serveur ;
  • Conception et administration de bases de données (sql, nosql ..)
  • Capacité à concevoir, documenter, tester et maintenir des applications robustes et évolutives ;

This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will use and help develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to ship quickly, applying the coding fundamentals and judgement needed to stand behind what reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step.

We are looking for:

  • Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

  • A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

  • Practical agentic engineering experience: you use coding agents effectively and can develop and evaluate their workflows, while independently understanding, reviewing and debugging the code they produce.

  • A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

  • Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Why Join

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.

We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

L'équipe tech compte cinq personnes : quatre développeurs, dont le Lead Tech, et une Product Owner. Le poste est le premier rôle QA de l'équipe. Il s'agit de poser les bases de la démarche qualité, avec une forte autonomie et sans dispositif QA préexistant. L'accélération de la production de code, notamment grâce aux outils d'assistance IA, rend nécessaire une meilleure capacité de validation avant livraison.

Mission

Accompagner et structurer la phase de recette afin que chaque livraison soit mise en production avec un niveau de confiance maîtrisé. Le QA Engineer fait de la qualité une responsabilité partagée par l'équipe, dès la conception et tout au long du développement. Il s'agit d'un rôle d'Individual Contributor, sans management, en lien étroit avec la Product Owner, le Lead Tech, les développeurs et les équipes métier.

Principales responsabilités

  • Définir avec la Product Owner les critères d'acceptation des fonctionnalités, idéalement sous forme de scénarios exécutables Given / When / Then.

  • Participer aux affinages, challenger les besoins et identifier les cas limites, les cas d'erreur et les impacts sur l'existant.

  • Co-construire avec le Lead Tech et les développeurs la stratégie de tests, en déterminant les niveaux de test et les priorités d'automatisation selon les risques.

  • Piloter la recette fonctionnelle : élaborer les plans de test, mener des tests exploratoires et organiser des campagnes de non-régression sur les parcours critiques.

  • Piloter la recette métier : organiser et animer les sessions, accompagner les utilisateurs dans la préparation et l'exécution des tests, consolider leurs retours et suivre les corrections jusqu'à validation.

  • Automatiser les tests fonctionnels API et bout en bout, les intégrer à la CI et maintenir une suite fiable.

  • Qualifier, reproduire et documenter les anomalies, puis les prioriser avec la Product Owner.

  • Évaluer la qualité avant livraison, définir les critères de sortie et partager les avis go / no-go avec la Product Owner et le Lead Tech.

  • Construire et entretenir des jeux de données de test factices et des environnements de recette exploitables, sans utiliser de données clients réelles.

  • Intégrer des vérifications de sécurité de base à la recette, notamment la validation des entrées, les droits d'accès et les comportements en cas d'erreur.

  • Suivre des indicateurs qualité pertinents, tels que les anomalies échappées en production, la couverture des parcours critiques et la durée de recette, puis proposer des améliorations.

  • Diffuser la culture qualité dans l'équipe, aider les développeurs à mieux tester leur code et partager les bonnes pratiques.

Environnement technique

  • Stack applicative : PHP, Symfony, MySQL

  • Tests : PHPUnit, tests unitaires et tests d'intégration

  • Automatisation et API : framework de tests bout en bout (Playwright, Cypress ou Selenium), outils de tests d'API (Postman, REST Assured ou Karate)

  • CI/CD : pipeline CI

  • Suivi et documentation : Jira, Confluence

  • Méthodes et pratiques : BDD, Gherkin, tests exploratoires, approche par les risques

Expérience

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en QA ou test logiciel dans un contexte agile ; poste non ouvert aux profils juniors.

  • Expérience avérée du pilotage de recette métier, incluant l'organisation de campagnes, l'accompagnement d'utilisateurs non techniques et l'arbitrage des retours avec le produit.

  • Expérience concrète de l'automatisation de tests bout en bout et de tests d'API.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de la rédaction de critères d'acceptation et de scénarios de test, avec une pratique de BDD / Gherkin.

  • Capacité à lire du code et à scripter, et compréhension d'une chaîne CI/CD.

  • Pratique des tests exploratoires et de l'approche par les risques.

  • Capacité à structurer une démarche qualité de manière autonome, à prioriser et à avancer sans cadre préétabli.

Compétences personnelles

  • Curiosité et exigence, avec une attention portée à l'utilisateur.

  • Approche pragmatique, en proportionnant l'effort de test aux risques.

  • Bonnes capacités de communication, pour signaler les problèmes de manière factuelle et constructive et faire le lien entre les métiers, le produit et la technique.

  • Pédagogie pour accompagner les utilisateurs métier dans la recette.

  • Esprit d'initiative et capacité à faire évoluer les pratiques.

  • Aisance avec les outils d'assistance IA, utilisés avec un regard critique.

Compétences / Qualités qui seraient un + :

Expérience en fintech, banque, e-commerce ou domaine réglementé ;

notions de tests de performance et de sécurité applicative (OWASP) ;

PHP / Symfony et outils associés (PHPUnit, Behat) ; SQL / MySQL ;

certification ISTQB ou équivalent.

Oui — 2 jours/semaine de télétravail

- Concevoir les abstractions permettant de manipuler le modèle métier

Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Als Senior Backend Engineer verantwortest du die Systeme hinter unserer Plattform: die GraphQL-API, das relationale Datenmodell, die Hintergrundverarbeitung, die Dokumente und Excel-Dateien unserer Kunden in strukturierte Daten verwandelt, und das Berechtigungsmodell, mit dem ein einzelner Eigentümer und eine Bank mit hunderten Portfolios dasselbe Produkt nutzen. Du übernimmst echte Verantwortung für Production: Wenn etwas langsam ist, findest du heraus, warum – egal ob die Antwort eine schlechte Query, Anwendungscode oder die Infrastruktur darunter ist.
Du hilfst uns außerdem, KI in Production zuverlässig zu machen. Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs und agentische Features sind zentral für die Richtung des Produkts - und wir brauchen Leute, die diese Workflows testbar und verlässlich machen, statt nur in der Demo beeindruckend.
Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

  • Du baust Features über unsere Hasura GraphQL-API, NestJS und Postgres - vom Schema-Design bis zum Resolver.

  • Du verantwortest die Hintergrundverarbeitung: Excel-Importe, Dokumentenextraktion, lang laufende Analyse-Jobs. Queues, Retries, Jobs, die andere Jobs starten - und die Frage, was passiert, wenn Schritt 3 von 7 um 2 Uhr nachts fehlschlägt.

  • Du integrierst LLMs in Backend-Workflows - vor allem für Dokumenten- und Datenextraktion - und machst sie zuverlässig und testbar.
  • Du debuggst Production. Du nutzt Grafana Dashboards und Traces, um herauszufinden, warum etwas langsam ist oder fehlschlägt - ob in der App, der CI/Build-Pipeline oder der Infrastruktur.
  • Du erkennst überwucherte oder unnötig komplexe Teile der Codebase und vereinfachst sie, ohne dass dich jemand darum bitten muss. Komplexität abzubauen gehört zum Job, ist kein Nebenprojekt.
